question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing center midfielder, Bob is playing right back, and Claire is playing right midfielder.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Finally, Bob and Alice trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) center midfielder
(B) right back
(C) right midfielder
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: center midfielder, right back, right midfielder
1. Claire ↔ Alice: right midfielder, right back, center midfielder
2. Bob ↔ Claire: right midfielder, center midfielder, right back
3. Bob ↔ Alice: center midfielder, right midfielder, right back
Alice is playing center midfielder, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
